seoTitle: Random Text Generator: Words, Sentences, Paragraphs, Characters
metaDescription: Generate random English words, sentences or paragraphs for placeholder text, or random characters from letters, digits and symbols.
intro: Create filler text or random strings with a secure random source.
why:
Words are drawn from a list of 250 common English nouns; sentences and paragraphs are built from them with capitals and full stops, so the text reads like language without meaning. Character mode picks from letters, letters and digits, digits, hex or a symbol set.

The character mode is good for test data but is not meant for passwords; use the password generator, which has strength guidance.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Choose words, sentences, paragraphs or characters.
Pick the character set if needed.

faq.a: Similar purpose, but it uses real English words rather than Latin-style filler.

faq.q: Can I get the same text twice?

faq.a: No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
